responsibility: This file implements the SPARC hooks used by the D front end. It registers SPARC and SPARC64 target version identifiers, exposes V8+ and hard-float versus soft-float capability through D builtin version strings, and answers D __traits(getTargetInfo, ...) queries such as floatAbi by returning target-specific string literals, thereby translating SPARC backend option state into the D language’s target-introspection interface.
